_comment: Time zones of the Canada pack: a curated dataset (CC BY 4.0, see datasets/LICENSE.md). packbuild.timezones turns it into the can pack's `timezones` polygon layer, which answers for points in Canada before the world pack's coarser layer. `admin1` has one entry per feature of the pack's provinces layer (statcan:<PRUID>): an IANA zone, or an object with `zone` (the rest of the province) and `parts` (census divisions statcan:<CDUID> and subdivisions statcan:<CSDUID> -> zone; a subdivision listed inside a listed division takes its own zone). A zone can be a list: the unit is split along a line the pack doesn't draw; the first entry is its main zone and the nearest town inside it whose zone is listed decides. Every zone must exist in the tz database; `sources` name entries of the top-level `sources`.

tzdb.title: IANA Time Zone Database 2026f: zone.tab and the commentary in northamerica

statcan:10.notes: Labrador (census divisions 10 and 11) is America/Goose_Bay, except its southeast corner, which keeps Newfoundland time ('the southeast corner, including Port Hope Simpson and Mary's Harbour, but excluding, say, Black Tickle', tzdb northamerica): the Labrador Straits towns, Port Hope Simpson, St. Lewis, Mary's Harbour, Charlottetown and Division No. 10, Subd. A; Subd. B (Black Tickle, the coast north to Cartwright) is split, so its towns decide. 'West Labrador' (Labrador City, Wabush) is listed with America/Halifax.

statcan:12.notes: zone.tab: America/Glace_Bay 'NS (Cape Breton)'; tzdb: Sydney 'shares the same time history as Glace Bay, so was likely to be the same across the island': the island's four counties (Inverness, Richmond, Cape Breton, Victoria).

statcan:24.notes: tzdb northamerica: America/Halifax 'also applies to Îles-de-la-Madeleine and the Listuguj reserve' (Legal Time Act, CQLR c T-5.1); east of Natashquan (the Lower North Shore: Blanc-Sablon, Bonne-Espérance, Saint-Augustin, Gros-Mécatina, Côte-Nord-du-Golfe-du-Saint-Laurent, Pakuashipi, Petit-Mécatina) keeps Atlantic standard time all year, America/Blanc-Sablon (zone.tab).

statcan:35.notes: Ontario's Time Act puts the part west of 90°W on Central time (America/Winnipeg), with the exceptions tzdb northamerica records (2026-09-21): the area around Big Trout Lake (Kitchenuhmaykoosib Aaki, Wapekeka, Kasabonika, Wawakapewin, Kingfisher, Wunnumin) aligns with Winnipeg east of 90°W; Upsala (in Thunder Bay, Unorganized) keeps Eastern west of it; Atikokan, Pickle Lake and Mishkeegogamang (Osnaburgh 63A, 63B) keep EST all year (America/Atikokan). Kenora District's subdivisions east of 90°W outside the Big Trout Lake area are Eastern. The two unorganized areas straddle 90°W, so their towns decide.

statcan:47.notes: tzdb northamerica: most of Saskatchewan is America/Regina; Swift Current (America/Swift_Current, zone.tab 'SK (midwest)'); Lloydminster is like Edmonton; Denare Beach and Creighton (and Flin Flon's Saskatchewan part) are like Winnipeg.

statcan:59.notes: tzdb northamerica: the Regional District of East Kootenay, the Town of Golden and Columbia Shuswap Area A (Rural Golden) are aligned with Alberta (America/Edmonton); Creston and the Creston Valley (Central Kootenay B and C) keep MST (America/Creston), Area A (Kootenay Lake's east shore) is listed with both; the Peace River Regional District is America/Dawson_Creek ('Dawson Cr, Ft St John'); the Northern Rockies Regional Municipality is America/Fort_Nelson.

statcan:60.notes: zone.tab: America/Dawson 'Yukon (west)', drawn as Dawson and Moosehide Creek; Whitehorse elsewhere.

statcan:61.notes: zone.tab: America/Inuvik 'NT (west)', drawn as the Inuvik region (census division 6101); America/Edmonton elsewhere.

statcan:62.notes: zone.tab: Iqaluit (most of Nunavut: Qikiqtaaluk), Rankin Inlet (Kivalliq), Cambridge Bay (Kitikmeot: 'Gjoa Haven, Taloyoak and Pelly Bay all use Mountain', tzdb), Resolute, and Coral Harbour on EST all year (America/Atikokan).
